doc.title: Roswell Rudd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998

title: Opening of the Hamilton interview
summary: Monk Rowe introduces the filming at the Catskills and Rudd as a creative trombonist; he notes Rudd began in Dixieland.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in the Catskills, and I am very pleased to have Roswell Rudd with me today, who is most likely one of the most creative trombonists in jazz history. I think I can safely say that if that’s all right with you.
That’s fine. Long as it will get things rolling.

That’s right. We’ve got to get things rolling somehow. It seems interesting to look at your career and know that you started playing Dixieland and went about as far on the spectrum as you could it seems like.
